mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right insulation R-value for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right R-value depends on your home's location, climate zone, and the specific area being insulated (attic, walls, floor). In Southern California, recommended R-values for attics typically range from R-30 to R-49, while walls generally require less. Higher R-values indicate greater thermal resistance. Our experts can assess your home's current insulation, consider local building codes, and recommend the optimal R-value to achieve maximum energy efficiency and comfort for your specific property.
